hint: The images show the same moment from {n} fixed camera{s}. A robot hand, palm up, holds a cube whose faces are coloured. The hand may hide parts of the cube.

up: Which colour covers most of the cube face that points up (toward the sky)?
turned: Look at the cube face where [1] marks the large 2/3 panel and [2] marks the narrow 1/3 strip along its split edge. Do [1] and [2] show the same colour, or two different colours?
band: Look at the cube face where [1] marks the red 2/3 panel and [2] marks the narrow 1/3 strip along its split edge. What colour is the strip marked [2]?
red (same colour as [1]; there is no different strip)
